title: Initial Configuration Representation
statement: For every Boolean input word $y$, the initial configuration of the specified one-tape machine in state $vU0$ on input $y$ equals the configuration with state $vU0$, input-head position $1$, the binary expansion of $0$ stored on its work tape beginning at cell zero, work-tape head at position $0$, and empty output.
